relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE<sub>2</sub> mediates its functions via four different G protein-coupled receptors, named EP1-EP4.

relationships.subject: NSAIDs
relationships.evidence_quote: Based on the inhibition of inflammatory PGE<sub>2</sub> production, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) are considered as the most commonly used drugs to treat inflammatory diseases

key_findings: EP1 is widely involved in inflammatory response, pain perception and multisystem pathological regulation.
